verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
All your ways are good
All your ways are sure
I will trust you alone

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Where you go I'll go
Where you stay I'll stay

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
When you move I'll move
I will follow you

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
Who you love I'll love
How you serve I'll serve

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
If this life I'll lose
I will follow you

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Higher than my sight
High above my life

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
I will trust in you alone
In you alone

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Light unto the world
Light unto my life
I will live for you alone

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines:
You're the one I seek
Knowing I will find

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines:
All I need in You alone
in You alone

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
In you is life everlasting
In you is freedom for my soul

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
In you is joy unending joy
I will follow you
